scope: All252 retained H Direct author native exec calls whose first shell word is git. All18 author sessions/39 author cycles; no reviewer/linearizer actions, provider generation, accounting, quality filtering or runtime change. All53 actual normal-WL applied-group ACKs independently indexed for supplied information.

method.selection: Deterministic prior H author order, then physical native line; first eligible cycle is point7-exact-direct feature1 initial turn. The census then covers every252 saved leading-Git calls and matches the earlier per-thread count.
method.native: Exact source-pinned public function_call exec_command input joined to same-thread/same-turn function_call_output by call_id. Only parsed command and public output shape/facts are inspected; no native reasoning body. Accepted apply_patch records are separately indexed by same turn and actual successful output.
method.phase: Every saved initial/fix prompt matches one native user item after terminal-LF-only trim; exact thread file matches the established author thread. Native task_started/task_complete identify39cycles. Every252 Git output timestamp precedes that cycle's task_complete, which precedes its retained host patch-accepted/review-fix-complete committed receipt. A prior-turn commit is not called the current-turn commit.
method.facts: Command variants identify status, uncommitted worktree-versus-index paths/body/stat/whitespace and restricted prose-path scope. No command contains a revision range, cached/staged selector, commit/log/show action or author Git write. This is a bounded census of leading-Git calls, not all Git inside arbitrary programs.
method.ack: All53 client turn/start ACK prompts match the exact renderer shape: applied header, files line, identical remaining text. Every request has an exact typed successful reply and unique identical complete public user item. This validates actual author-facing ACK facts, not an invented per-ACK commit-SHA join.
method.complexity: One native traversal and keyed outputs per author; accepted patches are stored once in a per-turn table. Each Git record references a prior count/last patch line rather than duplicating a history. Raw reply/user indexes are one-pass. Work/output linear in inspected public evidence bytes, apart from fixed bounded source/episode metadata.
method.source_qualification: All18 native and six report hashes match the established H pins; original H driver commits differ and are recorded perauthor. Saved prompt/thread/status/timeline files are freshly source-hashed and structurally joined, not claimed to be original manifest entries. Historical normal-WL orchestrator/patch source bytes are verified equal to git commit5b1d1ef9590850faed26052f909ddff7ff8f127d. Old four Direct commit objects could not be resolved in the main checkout; no current-driver identity is substituted.

ack_information.fixed_tail:
The orchestrator has already saved this patch as a provisional git commit. Do not resend this patch, do not rebase this same diff, and do not restate the patch body.
Next step: run at most one focused validation step that is relevant to files you touched or checks you added. Use `@work-leaf locks run <path>... -- <command>` when that command may write files.
Do not run another patch agent's focused tests as local validation. If a broad check is blocked only by another patch agent's owned files or tests, report that exact blocker once.
If validation fails in another feature's test or behavior, do not edit that test or unrelated implementation unless your patch clearly caused the failure.
After the focused validation passes, or after you report an external blocker, emit a top-level `@work-leaf done` so review can start. Send another edit only if validation found a concrete issue in your own patch.
